strategy: 先按前置条件安装并通读 skill threejs-materials-lighting，规则、数字和检查以它为准；其他游戏开发 skill 不要预装。
Use when a mesh renders black or washed out, shadows are missing or full of acne, or EffectComposer darkens the image.
Workflow: Rule out geometry first; Default to `MeshStandardMaterial`; Light the scene; Turn on shadows in three places.
